title: Frank Driggs's different version of stories
summary: Albert wonders what Driggs meant about a different version of events, possibly from Texas.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well a lot of guys had to work in the street and I think that you have to develop strength and tone and everything there.

So I was, I meant to ask you something Dick. Frank Driggs wrote and told me something and he says, well I have a different story from you than what Dick Allen says. I said, man I'd like to know what it is. He said, because everything I've told Dick is from my own chops.
I was wondering what it was, he never did tell me.
No, no, well there's a lot of different things.
Now maybe he was talking about something might have happened in Texas and we might have confused me. So that's something happened here.
